messages.content: Write the About page for a company that makes scheduling software for medical clinics. Around 250 words.

## About Frontdesk

Frontdesk exists because Maya Okonkwo answered phones for three years at a two-provider family practice in Akron, and the sticky notes finally beat her.

The schedule was the clinic's real operating system. It determined whether the day's last patient got seen, whether the nurse ate lunch, whether a 2:15 cancellation became forty minutes of empty room. And it ran on software written in 2004 that couldn't distinguish a 20-minute follow-up from a new-patient intake.

We build scheduling software for outpatient clinics: primary care, dermatology, physical therapy, behavioral health. Roughly 340 practices run on us, most with two to fifteen providers. Small enough that the office manager knows every patient by name. Large enough that one bad Tuesday costs real money.

In practice, that means provider templates that encode the actual rules (Dr. Reyes books no procedures after 3pm on Fridays), waitlist fill that texts the next patient within ninety seconds of a cancellation, and reminder logic that cut no-shows across our customer base from 18% to under 9% last year.

We sign a BAA. We're SOC 2 Type II. We don't sell patient data and never will, because there's no version of this company where that's up for discussion.

Twenty-two people, Cleveland, and about a third of us have worked a clinic job. Call support and you get someone who knows what a superbill is.

---
